text: Kala mo Allah hoyni gaa e peewal haa O majjini ontigi e goonga kan, haray giɗo goo alanaa mo, mo no heftana mo fiyakuuji makko ɗin. A tinay tooñirnooɓe ko'e mun ɓen geddi e keeferaaku, tuma ɓe yi'i lepte ɗen Ñalnde Darngal, hiɓe yeloo wi'a: hara laawol ruttorde aduna no woodi, men tuubana Allah?
